resources.string: Runs a private SearXNG search engine inside the Debian environment, reachable only from this phone. Leave the SearXNG address empty to use it.
Installing… this can take several minutes
Installed, stopped (starts on the next search)

This downloads the Debian environment copy (about 200 MB on disk) plus SearXNG and its Python packages (roughly 150 MB more) over the network, so use Wi-Fi.

While running it uses RAM next to your model, and it stops itself after 10 idle minutes. Search engines may block or CAPTCHA your phone's IP address, so some searches can return nothing and fall back to DuckDuckGo.

This feature is experimental.
This deletes the SearXNG files and its settings. You can install it again later.
